messages:
luis-m: Hey everyone — first week here! Quick setup issues: I docked my MacBook Pro and the battery icon shows 'Not charging' and it stays at 1%. Dock USB ports also drop my external keyboard randomly. Corp Wi‑Fi (redwood-corp) fails to connect — macOS shows 'certificate validation failed'. Monitor that arrived seems to have only DisplayPort cable, but the dock is USB-C only. Who should I ping? :sweat_smile:

ava-it: Welcome, @luis-m :wave: Sorry about that. Can you share the dock serial (it's on the underside) and run a couple quick checks? 1) paste output of `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` or `lsusb` (if you have it). 2) run `pmset -g batt` and paste. Also drop a photo of the underside sticker if possible. I'll open a ticket if needed.

luis-m: Dock SN: DCK-78A2F3. Here's the `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` snippet and `pmset` output:

```
USB:
  USB 3.1 Bus:
    Dock Inc. Dock Adapter:
      Product ID: 0x0a12
      Vendor ID: 0x1a2b
      Version: 1.00
      Speed: Up to 5 Gb/s
      Location ID: 0x14300000 / 6

Battery (Internal):
  Charge: 1%; Discharging
  -InternalBattery-0 (id=1234567)
```

Also pasted a short dmesg tail when I unplug/replug USB-C:```
usb 3-2: USB disconnect, device number 5
usb 3-2: new full-speed USB device number 6 using xhci_hcd
usb 3-2: can't set config #1, error -71
```

ava-it: Thanks. Error -71 usually indicates a hardware/firmware fault on the dock or cable. I'm going to create ticket TKT-9123 and request a hardware swap+fresh USB-C cable. For the Wi‑Fi cert: try the quick reinstall first — open System Settings > Profiles and check for the Redwood root cert. If it's missing, download and install from https://redwood.internal/it/kb/wifi-eap (requires corp VPN or inside network). If you can't access the KB, reply and I'll attach the profile here.

sam-se: Adding network context — we rotated the corp root cert yesterday afternoon for devices that had auto-enroll off. If you were imaged before the rotation, macOS will reject the AP cert. Two options: 1) connect to wired network or VPN and run the profile install, or 2) temporarily use the mobile hotspot and we'll push a one-time enable for your MAC addr. Prefer wired/VPN for security.

mike-facilities: @ava-it noted the swap. I scheduled a courier pickup for the defective dock tomorrow between 10–12 and a replacement will arrive the same day. Courier: FedEx Express. I'll DM the pickup label. Please confirm if 10–12 works, @luis-m.

luis-m: 10–12 is perfect, thanks! Quick Q on the monitor cable mismatch — is it okay to use a DP → USB-C adapter (I have one) or should I wait for a new USB-C monitor cable?

ava-it: DP→USB-C passive adapters are hit/miss. If the monitor supports DP Alt Mode over USB‑C then a passive cable is fine, but better to wait for the vendor‑approved cable we ship. I'll bundle a USB‑C cable with the replacement dock so you get a tested pair.

mike-facilities: Pickup label DM'ed to @luis-m. Replacement tracking: https://trackingsvc.example/fedex/ZX123456789 — ETA tomorrow 3pm local.

kit-bot: [hardware-swap] Created TKT-9123 and assigned to `ava-it`. Status: hardware_swap_scheduled -> pickup_confirmed.

luis-m: Amazing, thank you all! I'll try the VPN/profile install tonight and report back. :thumbsup:
